claim: To reach Crossref's polite pool via the User-Agent header, callers must include a mailto: contact address in that header (HTTPS required).
sub_question: What does CrossRef recommend for User-Agent to reach the polite pool?
evidence: Etiquette / polite pool section states two options for polite-pool routing; option 2 is User-Agent mailto.
quote_or_anchor: 2) Include a "mailto:" in your User-Agent header. For example: GroovyBib/1.1 (https://example.org/GroovyBib/; mailto:GroovyBib@example.org) BasedOnFunkyLib/1.4.
notes: Primary public REST API doc; raw README also at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CrossRef/rest-api-doc/master/README.md

claim: Crossref's exact etiquette recommendation for User-Agent is to identify the script/tool and provide email contact via mailto:.
sub_question: What is the exact verbatim User-Agent recommendation?
evidence: Etiquette bullet list gives the full User-Agent recommendation with example.
quote_or_anchor: Specify a User-Agent header that properly identifies your script or tool and that provides a means of contacting you via email using "mailto:". For example: GroovyBib/1.1 (https://example.org/GroovyBib/; mailto:GroovyBib@example.org) BasedOnFunkyLib/1.4.
notes: Verbatim etiquette recommendation; polite pool routing uses the mailto: portion of this pattern.

claim: Polite-pool routing requires HTTPS plus appropriate contact information in User-Agent or query parameters.
sub_question: What other conditions apply for polite pool routing?
evidence: Good manners section ties polite pool to HTTPS and contact info.
quote_or_anchor: As of September 18th 2017 any API queries that use HTTPS and have appropriate contact information will be directed to a special pool of API machines that are reserved for polite users.
notes: Confirms HTTPS + contact info prerequisite for polite pool.

claim: Current Crossref site also directs polite access to email in mailto parameter or agent/User-Agent header.
sub_question: Does current Crossref docs still recommend contact identity for polite access?
evidence: Access options table lists Polite as email in mailto or agent header.
quote_or_anchor: Polite | Include your email address in the mailto parameter or agent header.
notes: Corroborates GitHub doc; newer official site uses agent header wording.
